subject: Acme trial procurement follow-up: SOW, PO vs Marketplace, billing start
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Acme trial & procurement path (PO vs card) - next steps

Hi Jamie - great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:

Call highlights:
- Acme will run a 30-day evaluation focused on knowledge base summarization and support deflection.
- Success criteria: average summary quality >= 4.0 (on your internal rubric) and >= 20% reduction in initial support tickets for the pilot cohorts.
- Expected usage during trial: ~150k tokens/day across 5k conversations (estimate).

Procurement/commercial notes we discussed:
- Preferred procurement path: purchase via PO (procurement team).
- Marketplace interest: Acme asked about purchasing via AWS Marketplace - noted potential benefits for internal approval but may add a short lead time.
- Billing/start date: we typically provision trial access immediately. Billing for paid plans starts either when (a) the trial converts and a paid order is activated, or (b) an agreed production start date is reached. If you prefer billing via PO, we can align activation with the PO effective date.

Attachments I will send after this thread: redwood_trial_summary.pdf (trial account ops), SOW-draft-acme.docx (starter SOW), SOC2-report-2025.pdf.

Next steps / asks:
1) Please confirm the procurement contact and whether PO is the preferred method (you mentioned Samantha from procurement).
2) Confirm whether you want billing to start on an agreed production date or upon conversion/activation. If production date, suggest a proposed start (e.g., 2026-08-01).
3) Dev will follow up on IP allowlist and network requirements for provisioning.

I’ll prep the SOW and a short doc outlining trial-to-paid conversion mechanics so procurement has what they need. Thanks - looking forward to getting you set up.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme trial & procurement path (PO vs card) - next steps

Thanks Marissa - good summary. A few clarifications from my side:

- Procurement: yes, Samantha Reed is the procurement owner (procure@acme.com). They will prefer a PO.
- Compliance: procurement requires our SOC2 report and a short SOW that lists deliverables and trial length.
- Marketplace: we do prefer AWS Marketplace where possible - makes approvals easier, but if the SOW/contracting timeline is faster via direct PO, we can do that too. Important to know any differences in billing start when purchasing through Marketplace vs direct PO.
- Billing: we'd like to avoid automatic billing without explicit commercial activation. Ideally the trial would run, and we execute a PO to start paid service on an agreed production date. Can Redwood do that (i.e., provision trial access but only enable paid billing upon PO effective date)?

Also, can you confirm whether you track the trial usage threshold so we can see when we're about to exceed the trial credits? That will help us plan the PO amount.

I'll loop Samantha into procurement conversation next.

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Product Manager, Knowledge & Automation
jamie.liu@acme.com
